**EL-RSP-P2 BodyCan0 lighting control cycle**

BodyCan0 shall carry TurnLightControl every 50 ms, as one broadcast frame received by DIM, FLCM, RLCM and GWM, and its load shall let the frame be sent within its cycle.

description: Platform part of EL-RSP-1.2 (BCM_Lighting_IndicatorResponseTime). CommunicateAllocation_BodyCan0 places the Left/RightTurnLightRequest assemblies of ExteriorLightingDesign on BodyCan0.

The broadcast matters as much as the cycle: one transmission reaching every follower is what makes the CAN delay cancel out of the front/rear offset of EL-RSP-1, and what keeps the telltales in phase for EL-HAZ-1.
Evidence: frame 103 TurnLightControl with receivers DIM, FLCM, RLCM, GWM and GenMsgCycleTime 50 ms in body_can.dbc.
metadata.name: BodyCan0_LightingControl_Cycle
